items.title: Efficacy and safety of cholesterol-lowering treatment: prospective meta-analysis of data from 90,056 participants in 14 randomised trials of statins.
items.summary: Prospective meta-analysis of 90,056 participants in 14 randomized statin trials showing significant reduction in coronary heart disease and major vascular events per 1.0 mmol/L LDL cholesterol reduction.

items.title: Evolocumab and Clinical Outcomes in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: FOURIER trial of 27,564 patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease showing evolocumab (PCSK9 inhibitor) significantly reduced cardiovascular events when added to statin therapy.

items.title: Efficacy and safety of inclisiran versus PCSK9 inhibitor versus statin plus ezetimibe therapy in hyperlipidemia: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
items.summary: Network meta-analysis comparing efficacy and safety of inclisiran versus PCSK9 inhibitors versus statin plus ezetimibe therapy in hyperlipidemia treatment.

items.title: Cardiovascular events with PCSK9 inhibitors: an updated meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials.
items.summary: Updated meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials showing PCSK9 inhibitors efficiently reduce plasma cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular outcomes.

items.title: Alirocumab in Pediatric Patients With Heterozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: Phase 3 randomized trial evaluating alirocumab efficacy in pediatric patients aged 8-17 years with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia inadequately controlled on statins.

items.title: Risk of cardiovascular outcomes with bempedoic acid in high-risk statin intolerant patients: a systematic review and meta analysis.
items.summary: Systematic review and meta-analysis examining cardiovascular outcomes with bempedoic acid in high-risk statin intolerant patients.

items.title: Apolipoprotein B and Non-HDL Cholesterol Better Reflect Residual Risk Than LDL Cholesterol in Statin-Treated Patients.
items.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
items.summary: Study of 13,015 statin-treated patients showing apolipoprotein B and non-HDL cholesterol better reflect residual cardiovascular risk than LDL cholesterol.

items.title: Pediatric hyperlipidemia.

items.title: Statin-fibrate combination therapy.
items.summary: Clinical review providing recommendations for statin-fibrate combination therapy in refractory mixed hyperlipidemia with safety considerations.

items.journal: Current opinion in endocrinology, diabetes, and obesity

canonicalFacts.claim: Statins are the treatment of choice for hypercholesterolemia with proven efficacy in reducing cardiovascular events
PCSK9 inhibitors (evolocumab, alirocumab) significantly reduce LDL cholesterol by approximately 60% and improve cardiovascular outcomes
Atherosclerotic plaques originate early in childhood, making pediatric hyperlipidemia screening and management important
Apolipoprotein B and non-HDL cholesterol may better reflect residual cardiovascular risk than LDL cholesterol in statin-treated patients
Bempedoic acid can be an alternative for statin-intolerant patients

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Implement calorie-restricted diet for weight management in obese patients with hyperlipidemia
Consider dietary modifications as part of comprehensive hyperlipidemia management

redFlags: Statin-fibrate combination therapy increases risk of severe myopathy and rhabdomyolysis
Bezafibrate can cause rhabdomyolysis, especially when combined with other medications
